what_happened: Scene layout 8 / style 8 (same sink and lever as s4/s10/s22); colander with lettuce on the counter right of the sink, visible in the agent view. Stage 0: the gripper reached the lever at the right of the spout base at 88 (touch 88-187). The fingers closed at 166-186 beside the lever, on nothing (width 0.001), and the lever did not move (handle 0.00 rad all episode; the 6.28 samples at 128/160 are a tiny negative angle wrapped by mod 2pi). From ~220 the closed gripper rotated (wrist camera rolls >90 deg) and hovered around the spout base 220-640, a turning-like motion with only brief touches (360-368, 382-384, 415-416, 429-431, 501-515, 588-592) and no handle movement. Then, with the water still off, it moved to the colander (660-700) and hovered over the lettuce/colander for ~400 steps (700-1040), slowly approaching the colander rim; the fingers started closing near the rim at ~1050, too late. Water never on, washed_time 0.
causal_chain: fingers closed on air beside the lever (166-186) -> wrist-rotation 'turn' motion around the spout with closed fingers, lever never moved (220-640) -> moved on to the lettuce with the water off (660) -> hovered over the colander 700-1040 -> no washing possible with the water off; timeout at 1100
self_recovery: Several brief re-contacts with the lever/spout 360-592 did not move it. It then abandoned the faucet and moved on to stage 1 without water, which could not succeed.
official_criterion_notes: fixture value_every_16_steps shows 6.28 at steps 128 and 160: an angle a hair below 0 wrapped mod 2pi and then abs'd by the packet tooling (effective angle ~0), not a real turn.

packet_facts: handle 0.00 throughout (6.28 = wrapped tiny negative at 128,160)

uncertain_about: Whether the 220-640 motion was meant as a lever turn or as a search; either way the lever was not engaged.
